messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] inference-eu-west1 GPU pool at configured max nodes (maxNodes=16). Autoscaler reporting "Reached max node count" and we have sustained queue growth: request_queue ~= 1800. Throttling is active on non-enterprise routes. Severity: P1. Pagers: @Tara P, @Samir K.

Tara P: ack. I'm on it. Can someone confirm whether this is hitting cloud quota or autoscaler policy?

Samir K: pulling autoscaler logs now. preliminary: cluster-autoscaler log shows repeated "no scale up possible: max node count reached" msgs. Not a quota error in GCP API right now.

Maria G: seeing a lot of 429/503 from the fronting gateway for queued requests. Throttle metric spiked 12:03 UTC. Customers with reserved capacity unaffected, but self-serve tiers are seeing queuing + 1000ms token latency increases.

Tara P: ok. We need a short-term mitigation: request manual increase of maxNodes for this pool. Samir, can you confirm safe headroom we can open? Ops runbook says emergency cap can be raised +25% w/ approval from oncall lead.

Samir K: current maxNodes=16, desired temporary cap=20. Before we do, validating node quota: gcloud compute resource-quotas shows GPUs available in eu-west1 for our project = 50, used by other clusters ~28, so we're ok to add 4 nodes for the pool.

Eric V: FYI some nodes take ~6-8 minutes to join and warm caches; prefix/KV cache miss will cause extra tail latency. Recommend also enabling temporary fallback to smaller model variant for low-tier customers to reduce GPU consumption while nodes spin up.

Tara P: good point. Maria, can you enable model-fallback rule for routes "public-gen-*"? Make it timeboxed.

Maria G: on it — policy staged, will flip in ~30s. route config snippet:
```json
{
  "route": "public-gen-*",
  "fallback_model": "gpt-small-quant",
  "duration": "30m",
  "reason": "emergency-outage-reduction"
}
```

Samir K: performing manual override on cluster autoscaler config now. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap cluster-autoscaler --patch '{"data":{"maxNodes":"20"}}'
```
Applying...

oncall-bot: Note: manual override requires operator confirmation.

Samir K: confirmed, patched configmap and restarted CA controller. Also updated managed instance group targetSize via gcloud to request 4 additional nodes: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-inference-eu-west1 --size=20 --zone=europe-west1-b`

oncall-bot: [ACTION] Manual cap change recorded. old_max=16 new_max=20 executor=Samir K time=1791231800 UTC.

CS Bot: Notified top-10 impacted customers (IDs: C-1034, C-2190, C-4451) with templated message. They were informed of degraded performance and mitigation steps. No data loss.

Maria G: within 6 minutes nodes are provisioning. queue length peaked at 2.1k then trending down. Throttle rate dropping.

Eric V: rolling warmup in progress. We're seeing pods scale, but initial token throughput per second still limited until KV caches populated.

Tara P: thanks team. Keep monitoring. Samir, please keep the cap at 20 for now; we'll evaluate after backlog clears. Also create an incident lead note: I'll take lead for post-incident follow-up.

Samir K: ack. leaving a small script to revert if we detect sustained low utilization:
```
# revert-if-unused.sh (crude)
util=$(kubectl -n infra get hpa inference-workers -o jsonpath='{.status.currentMetrics[0].averageValue}')
if [ "$util" -lt "20%" ]; then
  kubectl -n infra patch configmap cluster-autoscaler --patch '{"data":{"maxNodes":"16"}}'
fi
```

Tara P: Maria, did fallback reduce GPU QPS?

Maria G: yes — after fallback flip, GPU QPS down ~28% for public routes. That shaved off a bunch of short jobs, backlog decreasing.

oncall-bot: [STATUS] backlog=420 -> 1801232400 UTC snapshot. (This bot posts periodic metrics only).

Eric V: one oddity: a couple of kube-scheduler pods reported ImagePullBackOff for new nodes; I manually hit restart on the daemonset and they recovered. No customer impact tied to that.

Tara P: good catch. Samir, any GCP quota alerts?

Samir K: no. GPU quota headroom still fine. We should still file a capacity request with cloud ops for long-term needs.

Tara P: agreed. Action items:
- Samir: file capacity increase request with cloud ops + retain manual maxNodes=20 until backlog <100 and 15m stable.
- Maria: keep fallback policy active for 30m window, then evaluate rollback.
- Eric: validate node image/daemonset failures in staging (post-incident).
- Tara: lead postmortem; collect timeline + customer impact.

Maria G: backlog at ~300 now, throttle ~1.2% and decreasing.

oncall-bot: [RESOLVE?] backlog < 500 and throttling <= 1% for 2 consecutive 5-min windows will be considered stabilized.

Tara P: we hit stabilization criteria at 1791235400 UTC. Leaving manual cap at 20 for monitoring, will follow up with timeline notes. Will open postmortem doc and assign. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
